Five further exchange-session opens after base

data_assumptions.proposal: Retain all fixed 100 historical members and every required ownership branch; no survivor replacement or dropping problematic identities
For any development diagnostic, explicitly label accepted vendor ex-date/rate/split fields and causal event timing per case; do not mark them independent primary-source verification

Never fabricate a payable date. When absent, retain earned dividend rights as unspendable throughout the window. Where payable terms exist, compare first actual open strictly after payable date, five more sessions, and no in-window credit. Report nominal claims separately from spendable/after-exit cash

Provider records alone do not certify historical public availability. No dividend-prediction/announcement trading. Any diagnostic effective-date knowledge convention must be separately stated and approved; strict known-at gates remain blocked without sources
Preserve original stable identity only for independently supported pure renames; obtain exact bounded alias intervals and real subsequent raw quotes before joining
Require supported parent/child/acquirer identity, ratios, cash terms, delivery scenarios, fractions and valuation. No free current-price replacement, invented terminal sale or zero recovery

No new discretionary entries in unselected children/acquirers. Inherited shares remain valued and are sold at the first supported regular open after delivery under a predeclared disposal policy and costs; unknown delivery blocks that case
DLPH/XL/LLL/MON unsegmented streams cannot execute as their original 2016 issuer. Partition using independent lifetime evidence without deleting preserved original payloads

gates_before_performance: Resolve every selected identity and ownership/valuation branch; source-backed CBS transition still missing

Owner reviews exact expanded assumptions and higher-exposure/count arms

reporting: All five arms and 120 attempted cases, including failures, incompletes and halts
Whole-account after-cost CAGR, realized P&L, estimated share exits and unspendable rights separately
Average/maximum exposure, exposure above entry caps after price drift, cash and drawdown
Entry blocker counts: slots, total exposure, single-name, cash, stop risk, volatility and signal absence; record simultaneous blockers if claiming all reasons
Daily-OHLC downside bounds, concentrations, correlation/sector limits not implemented, turnover and holding duration
Apply unchanged 6% CAGR and 5%drawdown rejection plus five-instrument/30-trade and other accepted gates; no threshold change or best-arm-only promotion
approval_method: Owner can review/approve in chat; engineer records a separate dated approval against finalized input/assumption hashes. No paper-risk JSON changes in this proposal.
